description: Defines interfaces and classes related to media tracks in Android's media framework, including MediaTrack interface, ReadOptions struct, and MediaTrackCUnwrapper class.

classes.name: SourceBaseAllocTracker
classes.description: Tracks allocation and deallocation of media source objects, logs creation and destruction.

classes.name: MediaTrack
classes.description: Interface for media track operations including start, stop, getFormat, and read.

classes.name: MediaTrackCUnwrapper
classes.description: Implementation of MediaTrack that wraps a CMediaTrack object, providing media track functionalities.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the media track for reading.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the media track, releasing resources.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the format of the media data.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the media track into a buffer.

methods.name: supportNonblockingRead
methods.description: Indicates if non-blocking read is supported.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a MediaTrackCUnwrapper instance wrapping a CMediaTrack.

methods.name: setSeekTo
methods.description: Sets a seek position and mode.

methods.name: getSeekTo
methods.description: Retrieves the current seek position and mode.

methods.name: setNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets the read options to non-blocking.

methods.name: getNonBlocking
methods.description: Checks if non-blocking read is enabled.
